newsitem.title: UK: BT looking at new call charge packages.
newsitem.headline: BT looking at new call charge packages.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc said on Monday that it was considering offering packages of pre-paid local calls to customers in exchange for higher rental charges.

Commenting on newspaper reports that BT planned to offer "free" local calls, a spokesman said the company was looking at a scheme under which customers could pay in advance for a batch of local calls.

"If a customer were to pay a higher quarterly rental charge, he would be offered several hours of unmetered local calls," the spokesman said, adding that this was something BT anticipated introducing at some point in the future.
"This is the way our pricing may well evolve," the spokesman added, noting such schemes were common in the United States.
Any alteration to BT's pricing structure has to be approved by telecoms regulator Oftel but that body has already signalled its backing for such a move.
The scheme would be popular with the growing number of Internet users who make large numbers of local calls.
